model_settings.status: descriptive (the design log, item 4): how often each per-model harness setting fired in each arm, to show the settings do not differ by arm; it is never confirmatory and changes no arm's numbers

definitions.bank: the same source's bank arm: recall W_F / W, false-flag rate C_F / C, unknown rate U / N_out, pooled counts
definitions.non_empty: outputs (items) whose checked query returned rows (result_rows > 0, feat/baselines' 'returns_rows' stratum): catches and false flags on them over N_att; on the bank, recall and false-flag rate over the non-empty items; not estimable when no row count is recorded
definitions.not_flagged: only status F is a flag: an unknown (U) and a vacuous pass count as not flagged
definitions.per_attempt: catches W_F, false flags C_F, fixes (wrong, flagged, right after the retry) and corruptions (right, flagged, wrong after it), each over N_att: a question's mean over its attempts, then over questions
definitions.reference: retry on empty ('empty-retry'): it flags exactly the outputs whose result had no rows
definitions.rows: one per graph x cohort x use x source, its arms' units pooled over models, then prereg §3's weighting; 'by_model' gives the same row per model (the appendix table, no predictions)
definitions.status: descriptive (prereg §7, the design log): it frames the bank claims and is never confirmatory

scorer_changes.status: descriptive (the design log): the verdicts the frozen scorer changes against scorer-rules-v4; it is never confirmatory and changes no arm's numbers

settings.exact_bounds: Clopper-Pearson for binary question-level events only (prereg §3)
settings.interval: percentile over defined resamples, inverted-CDF quantiles (prereg §4)
settings.resampling: complete question vectors, stratified by template x tier, one matrix for every arm (prereg §4)
settings.status: per-arm numbers are exploratory (prereg §6); the confirmatory analysis is under 'confirmatory' (its own unstratified resampling, prereg §4.2)
settings.weighting: proportions over N_att averaged per question then over questions; ratios as pooled counts (prereg §3)
